notes: v1.0.0-proposed mixed a hard overrun rule with a generated-files soft cap and did not define additions+deletions or a comparison SHA. That is withdrawn.
This file is not product intent. Approving it is a GATE-1 human choice.
Owners are CODEOWNERS teams, not invented individuals.

comparison_sha.name: freeze_sha
comparison_sha.rule: Every node loc_delta and files_touched is computed against the freeze SHA named in the bound GATE-1 APPROVE. After a prior node merges, the comparison remains freeze_sha...node_HEAD so earlier in-scope nodes are included in later diffs only if those paths are re-touched. Per-node accounting uses git diff freeze_sha...node_HEAD restricted to node.owned_files.

loc_delta.formula: sum(additions) + sum(deletions) from git --numstat for owned paths
loc_delta.includes: every line Git counts as added or deleted, including tests, docs, generated output, lockfiles, and OpenAPI

files_touched.definition: unique paths in the node diff

generated_output_verification.rule: If a node writes generated paths, the node must list them in node.generated_outputs, name the generator command, and re-run that command in the node worktree. git diff --exit-code on those paths must be clean after regeneration.

enforcement.overrun_if: loc_delta > node.budget.max_loc OR files_touched > node.budget.max_files OR aggregate_loc_delta > aggregate.max_loc OR aggregate_files_touched > aggregate.max_files OR generated_output_verification_failed

aggregate.applies_to: all in-scope AC-20 DAG nodes combined, vs freeze_sha
aggregate.note: The evidence-packet tree is excluded only while GATE-1 is unsigned. Aggregate numbers are proposed and do not authorize scope.

service-feature.use_when: one service behavior change with tests

security-narrow.use_when: tenant isolation, authz, or export-path hardening

frontend-slice.use_when: one Value Studio / web slice behind an existing seam

contract-metadata.use_when: additive schemas/registries; generated OpenAPI still counts and must verify

test-debt.use_when: closing skips/xfails without product behavior change

evidence-docs.use_when: pipeline evidence tree only; this PR class; outside AC-20 aggregate

ops-manifest.use_when: ArgoCD/WAL-G/OTel manifests without app feature work

gate_2.trigger: the overrun_if predicate in this file
